This feels right. The inline review panel is calm and prominent enough without interrupting me, and the preview image, icon, source, and saved date are placed sensibly. The invalid-address message and accepting `nytimes.com` behave as I’d expect.

Opening the existing entry when I try to save a duplicate is exactly what I meant.

The address should also be editable later. If I change it, I’d expect the app to fetch the new page’s details and let me review them, while preserving any title or description I deliberately wrote unless I choose to replace them. It should also prevent me from changing the address to one that is already saved. Beyond that correction, I’m happy with this save-and-edit flow.
